notes: Only the first constructor parameter is retained as a field (@JvmField anInt400, exposed and read everywhere this class is used, e.g. ScriptOpcodeHolder.kt's ConfigIdPair(14, 0)/(15, 4)/(16, -2)/etc. and ClanChatRequestSender.kt/Client.kt/SceneNodeDeque.kt reading `.anInt400` to write it as a packet opcode byte). The second constructor argument is never stored or read anywhere inside this class body -- it is accepted and silently discarded. Given ScriptOpcodeHolder's varying values (0, 4, -2, 6, 9, -1, ...) it plausibly represented an 'argument count' or 'payload length' companion to the opcode id in the original code, lost during decompilation/obfuscation; kept as a best-effort name.

Override always throws IllegalStateException() after incrementing companion counter anInt402 -- the same 'stripped toString stub' pattern seen in ConfigFlagUtil and other classes in this codebase; not a real string formatter.
